integrity_notes.proof_method: Exhaustive finite enumeration with independent fort-hitting and direct-forcing implementations; BFS on all filtered exchange graphs.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the twelve-vertex Frucht graph, the synchronous standard color-change rule, and unrestricted one-vertex replacement.
Exhaustive finite certificates prove the finite classification but do not imply a statement for all cubic or asymmetric graphs.
Historical research under alternate terminology or in unindexed tables could imply the result; independent scholarly review has not been performed.
title: A sharp propagation-time connectivity threshold for Frucht zero-forcing exchanges
